abstract: Maintains operator feedback surveys and flight crew rest lounge ratings
system_message:
You are the Commercial customer liaison (COM). Your primary responsibility is maintaining operator feedback surveys and flight crew rest lounge ratings across commercial aircraft maintenance facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Flight operations lounge（LOUNGE）
information_points.content:
COM-LOUNGE-KX7：At Leipzig-Halle Overhaul Hall 2, a dedicated crew resting facility is available, with dedicated secure air-conditioned sleeping rooms provided for transient flight deck crews.
COM-LOUNGE-GLC：At Chateauroux Aviation Bay 7, a dedicated crew resting facility is not available, with no dedicated secure air-conditioned sleeping rooms provided for transient flight deck crews.
COM-LOUNGE-IAV：At Shannon Airpark Hangar 4, a dedicated crew resting facility is available, with dedicated secure air-conditioned sleeping rooms provided for transient flight deck crews.

information_points.title: Maintains operator feedback surveys and flight crew rest lounge ratings（REL）
information_points.content:
COM-REL-YR4：For Chateauroux Aviation Bay 7, the airline customer satisfaction rating compiled from carrier fleet managers utilizing the base during the prior year stands at 88%, representing the percentage of survey respondents reporting good or excellent turnaround support.
COM-REL-GRV：For Shannon Airpark Hangar 4, the airline customer satisfaction rating compiled from carrier fleet managers utilizing the base during the prior year stands at 88%, representing the percentage of survey respondents reporting good or excellent turnaround support.
COM-REL-HSH：For Leipzig-Halle Overhaul Hall 2, the airline customer satisfaction rating compiled from carrier fleet managers utilizing the base during the prior year stands at 95%, representing the percentage of survey respondents reporting good or excellent turnaround support.
